name: vibeheader
description: Lightweight, ad-free HTTP header editor for Chrome with one-click shareable configs. A clean ModHeader alternative.

scripts.pretest:e2e: npm run clean && npm run build:prod
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run clean && npm run build:prod && playwright test --headed
scripts.zip:prod: BUILD_ENV=prod NODE_ENV=production rollup -c && node -e 'const {execSync}=require("child_process"); const v=(require("./dist/manifest.json").version)||""; const cmd="rm -f vibeheader-"+v+".zip && zip -r vibeheader-"+v+".zip dist -x \"*.DS_Store\""; execSync(cmd,{stdio:"inherit"});'
scripts.zip:only: node -e 'const {execSync}=require("child_process"); const v=(require("./dist/manifest.json").version)||""; const cmd="rm -f vibeheader-"+v+".zip && zip -r vibeheader-"+v+".zip dist -x \"*.DS_Store\""; execSync(cmd,{stdio:"inherit"});'

author: VibeHeader
